title: Number of Silver Support Scheme Beneficiaries
what_it_is: Number of Silver Support Scheme Beneficiaries

sections.label: Silver Support and ComCare recipients
sections.summary: Over 152,000 seniors received Silver Support payouts in 2017, and around 6,100 of them also received ComCare financial assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Over 152,000 seniors received Silver Support payouts in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Of these, around 6,100 were also recipients of ComCare financial assistance.

sections.label: ComCare and Silver Support eligibility
sections.summary: ComCare long-term assistance does not affect Silver Support eligibility, but for short-term ComCare Support the SSO considers all incomes, including SSS.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: For example, if they are receiving ComCare long-term assistance, then, in fact, it would not affect their eligibility for a Silver Support payout and vice versa.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: But there are recipients of ComCare Support who are receiving the support for only an interim period, for the short term.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: As a result, the SSO will take into account all of the incomes that they have, including what they may be receiving under SSS.
